biocs.name: Rare Windows Remote Management (WinRM) HTTP Activity
biocs.description: Detection of unusual WinRM HTTP activity originating from a host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter dst_port = 5985 and action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.10')
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'winrm.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'powershell.exe'
